config.name: Cells, faulted first
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT f.cell AS "Cell",
       f.site AS "Site",
       round(min(f.rsrp), 1) AS "Worst RSRP dBm",
       round(any(f.rsrp_base), 1) AS "Normal RSRP dBm",
       round(100 * min(f.rate_ratio)) AS "Lowest Mbps per user, % of normal",
       countIf(f.rsrp_drop) AS "RSRP drop periods",
       countIf(f.collapse) AS "Collapse periods",
       any(g.missing) AS "Silent periods",
       multiIf("Silent periods" > 0, 'silent', "Collapse periods" > 0, 'throughput collapse', "RSRP drop periods" > 0, 'RSRP drop', 'normal') AS "State"
FROM (SELECT k._timestamp AS _timestamp, k.cell AS cell, k.site AS site, k.rsrp AS rsrp, b.rsrp_base AS rsrp_base, k.users AS users,
         k.dl / greatest(k.users, 1) / b.rate_base AS rate_ratio,
         k.rsrp < b.rsrp_base - 8 AS rsrp_drop,
         k.dl / greatest(k.users, 1) < 0.25 * b.rate_base AND k.rsrp >= b.rsrp_base - 3 AS collapse
  FROM (SELECT _timestamp, toString(_json.cell) AS cell, toString(_json.site) AS site, toFloat64(_json.rsrp_dbm) AS rsrp, toFloat64(_json.dl_throughput_mbps) AS dl, toFloat64(_json.active_users) AS users FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)) AS k
  INNER JOIN (SELECT toString(_json.cell) AS cell, median(toFloat64(_json.rsrp_dbm)) AS rsrp_base, median(toFloat64(_json.dl_throughput_mbps) / greatest(toFloat64(_json.active_users), 1)) AS rate_base FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` GROUP BY cell) AS b ON k.cell = b.cell) AS f
LEFT JOIN (SELECT cell, toUInt64(sum(dateDiff('second', started, ended)) / 300) AS missing FROM (SELECT cell, site, previous + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AS started, _timestamp AS ended
  FROM (SELECT _timestamp, toString(_json.cell) AS cell, toString(_json.site) AS site,
               lagInFrame(_timestamp, 1, toDateTime64(0, 3, 'UTC')) OVER (PARTITION BY cell ORDER BY _timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS previous
        FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
  WHERE toUnixTimestamp(previous) > 0 AND dateDiff('second', previous, _timestamp) > 360) GROUP BY cell) AS g ON f.cell = g.cell
GROUP BY f.cell, f.site
ORDER BY "Silent periods" + "Collapse periods" + "RSRP drop periods" DESC, "Worst RSRP dBm"
LIMIT 20

config.name: Downlink throughput (Mbps), faulted cells
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp) AS ts,
       toString(_json.cell) AS cell,
       avg(toFloat64(_json.dl_throughput_mbps)) AS "Mbps"
FROM dfe.`ran-kpis`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp) AND toString(_json.cell) IN (
  SELECT cell FROM (SELECT k._timestamp AS _timestamp, k.cell AS cell, k.site AS site, k.rsrp AS rsrp, b.rsrp_base AS rsrp_base, k.users AS users,
         k.dl / greatest(k.users, 1) / b.rate_base AS rate_ratio,
         k.rsrp < b.rsrp_base - 8 AS rsrp_drop,
         k.dl / greatest(k.users, 1) < 0.25 * b.rate_base AND k.rsrp >= b.rsrp_base - 3 AS collapse
  FROM (SELECT _timestamp, toString(_json.cell) AS cell, toString(_json.site) AS site, toFloat64(_json.rsrp_dbm) AS rsrp, toFloat64(_json.dl_throughput_mbps) AS dl, toFloat64(_json.active_users) AS users FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)) AS k
  INNER JOIN (SELECT toString(_json.cell) AS cell, median(toFloat64(_json.rsrp_dbm)) AS rsrp_base, median(toFloat64(_json.dl_throughput_mbps) / greatest(toFloat64(_json.active_users), 1)) AS rate_base FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` GROUP BY cell) AS b ON k.cell = b.cell) WHERE rsrp_drop OR collapse UNION ALL SELECT cell FROM (SELECT cell, site, previous + INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AS started, _timestamp AS ended
  FROM (SELECT _timestamp, toString(_json.cell) AS cell, toString(_json.site) AS site,
               lagInFrame(_timestamp, 1, toDateTime64(0, 3, 'UTC')) OVER (PARTITION BY cell ORDER BY _timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS previous
        FROM dfe.`ran-kpis` WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp))
  WHERE toUnixTimestamp(previous) > 0 AND dateDiff('second', previous, _timestamp) > 360))
GROUP BY ts, cell
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Downlink PRB utilisation (%) by site
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp) AS ts,
       toString(_json.site) AS site,
       avg(toFloat64(_json.prb_util_dl_pct)) AS "PRB %"
FROM dfe.`ran-kpis`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)
GROUP BY ts, site
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Active users by site
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT ts, site, sum(users) AS "users"
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp) AS ts, toString(_json.site) AS site, toString(_json.cell) AS cell, avg(toFloat64(_json.active_users)) AS users
  FROM dfe.`ran-kpis`
  WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp)
  GROUP BY ts, site, cell)
GROUP BY ts, site
ORDER BY ts
